dedupe_keys.name: zone reglementee du plan de prevention du risque naturel pprn pour mouvements de terrain et sur risque sismique des vallees de la largue et du traubach dans le haut rhin

description: Zone réglementée du Plan de Prévention du Risque Naturel (PPRN) pour Mouvements de terrain et sur-risque sismique des vallées de la Largue et du Traubach dans le Haut-Rhin is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. For natural PPRs, the Environmental Code defines two categories of zones (L562-1):risk-exposed areas and areas that are not directly exposed to risks but where measures can be foreseen to avoid exacerbating the risk. Depending on the hazard level, each area is subject to an enforceable settlement. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Dataset Direct Download Service (WFS): Natural Risk Prevention Plan (NRPP) Regulated Area for Land Movements and Seismic" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WFS 1.1.0. The listing shows 2021-01-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
